messages.subject: Thames Valley office take-up rebounds; Reading leads regional yields
messages.plaintextBody:
PROPERTY WEEK DAILY

Top stories: Thames Valley office take-up rose 14% in Q1 as occupiers committed to fitted space; Reading recorded the strongest prime yield compression of the regional cities; a £200m logistics portfolio comes to market in the Midlands.
